stemMarkdown: 24 workers, each working 6 hours a day, can complete a job in 19 days. How many days will 8 workers, each working 10 hours a day, take to complete the same job? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total work $= 24 \times 19 \times 6$ worker-hours $= 2736$. With 8 workers at 10 hours/day, days needed $= \dfrac{2736}{8\times10} = 34.20$.
